items.title: Viatris (NASDAQ:VTRS) misses Q3 2026 sales expectations but beats adjusted EPS consensus estimates
items.summary: Medication company Viatris (NASDAQ:VTRS) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue flat year on year at $3.75 billion. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ consensus estimates, with revenue guided to $14.8 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.71 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
